name: grid
title: Grid
description: One row per voxel cell, pre-gridded (BAM Reach's reach map as rows). The producer's sidecar carries cell_mm (the cell's edge) and frame at its top level.

sidecar.frame: the frame of the cells' centres

fields.name: value
fields.description: the cell's value (e.g. the fraction of orientations reachable)
